facts: NYISO CAPITL, 2026-09-04 to 2026-10-03: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 19:00 local, 8.01 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 17:00, -8.0 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: 6.19 USD/MWh.
